Environment and Climate Change Canada (2025). Regulations Amending the Regulations Respecting Reduction in the Release of Methane and Certain Volatile Organic Compounds (Upstream Oil and Gas Sector), SOR/2025-280, with Regulatory Impact Analysis Statement. Canada Gazette, Part II, Volume 159, Number 27, 31 December 2025 (registered 12 December 2025, P.C. 2025-938). Ottawa.

Source is a saved web page (.mhtml) of the Canada Gazette; it has no page numbers, so locators are table and section names of the RIAS (Tables 1-8 in Costs of compliance). Loaded: per-unit capital and annual operating costs per compliance action (Tables 1-6, 8) and cost per survey (Table 7), all in 2023 CAD (RIAS states non-2023 values were inflated with the GDP deflator and USD converted at 2023 PPP). Not loaded as parameters: number of affected devices and present value costs (kept in other-values), methane reductions by source (Table 12, whole-programme Mt CH4 2028-2040, other-values). The RIAS does NOT print methane avoided per device, so no capacity row was possible; cost per t CH4 must come from other sources (ICF 2015, EPA). Cost bases are mostly not stated in the RIAS (the text says purchase and install only for VRU, flare ignition, combustor, catalytic oxidizer); those are recorded INSTALLED, the rest COST BASIS NOT STATED. Annual operating costs are not split into labour/fuel. Costs are derived by ECCC from Process Ecology (2023), Delphi (2017), ICF (2015), Natural Gas STAR (2006, 2011): partly reprinted. Gas composition by province (Table 11) not extracted. Part 2 (alternate compliance, site monitoring) was not costed in the RIAS.
